name: @pinepaper.studio/mcp-ffmpeg
description: Optional add-on for @pinepaper.studio/mcp-server: the only code that starts ffmpeg / ffprobe (from PATH, via execFile, no shell). Install it beside the server to turn on AAC delivery for MP4s made on Linux, the saved-file check, per-scene caching and bitrate caps. Contains no FFmpeg.
author: PinePaper Studio
